instance.description: The instance to create the database on.
instance.rationale: This is a required reference to the parent Spanner instance. It does not directly introduce a security risk but must be correctly configured to ensure the database is created in the intended instance.

name.description: A unique identifier for the database, which cannot be changed after the instance is created.
name.rationale: The database name is a required identifier and cannot be changed after creation. It does not directly introduce a security risk but should follow naming conventions to avoid naming confusion.

enable_drop_protection.description: Whether drop protection is enabled for this database. Defaults to false.
enable_drop_protection.rationale: Enabling drop protection prevents accidental or unauthorised dropping of the Cloud Spanner database, protecting critical data from being permanently lost.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: The project field is optional and defaults to the provider project. It does not directly introduce a security risk but should be explicitly set to avoid deploying resources to unintended projects.
